status: UNRUN -- no media processed, no measurements taken

statusMeaning.gate1NoSpeech: NOT EVALUATED -- a run with no media cannot test invented speech over silence
statusMeaning.gate2Comparison: NOT EVALUATED -- no engine was invoked, so there is nothing to compare
statusMeaning.note: An empty-corpus run demonstrates the harness executes and the rights-basis refusal works. It is not a measurement and must never be reported as one.

baseline.invocation: python -m faster_whisper CLI (or the faster-whisper script)

vad.note: evaluated explicitly, never left at a library default

baseline.note: language: null means auto-detect, reported per clip. Translation is never enabled.

challenger.note: Translation and any optional LLM rewrite are DISABLED. An enabled rewriter compared against a raw engine is not a comparison (Gate 2).
challenger.isolationNote: Its recognition modules read shared application configuration; if isolating the transcription task proves impractical that is a FINDING to report, not a problem to fight (patch Risk 3).

noSpeech.rule: Any invented speech on any negative input FAILS that configuration and no other result redeems it.

comparison.attributionRequired: Any pyVideoTrans advantage must be attributed to audio preprocessing, segmentation, or different model settings (patch Gate 2 and criterion 7).

phaseANote: Phase A: no media collected, nothing installed, nothing measured. Fill corpus.json `clips` from an owner-approved corpus to run Phase B.
